whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Royal Thali,

I noticed your restaurant has phenomenal 4.8★ reviews with nearly 2,000 happy diners in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table bookings and home delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table reservation, aur authentic thali gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/royalthali

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Royal Thali, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering, table booking, and a showcase of your top-rated thalis in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur contact setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
